statement: Review tramadol with a concurrent SSRI, or during phenelzine or tranylcypromine treatment or its 14-day washout.

plain_summary: Review tramadol with a concurrent SSRI, or during phenelzine or tranylcypromine treatment or its 14-day washout.
rule_for_models: Report and cite both supplies if tramadol overlaps an SSRI, phenelzine or tranylcypromine in either start order, or starts within 14 days after the last phenelzine or tranylcypromine dose (the next day is day 1 and day 14 counts), regardless of indication or other serotonergic medicines. Use recorded course dates first, otherwise calculate the last dose from quantity and directions, counting the start date as day one and using the supply date if no other start is recorded. Give no finding if both overlap and washout are ruled out, but if when-needed use or unclear dates leave either possible, cite both supplies, report only a possible finding and ask when the medicines were taken.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish actual use, indication or a prescriber’s intent. Treatment and assessments elsewhere may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you review the tramadol interaction with the recorded SSRI, or its timing during phenelzine or tranylcypromine treatment and in the 14 days after the last dose, as applicable?
